notes.title: Add New Mode!!
notes.notes:
Hello, I'm a developer.

Thank you very much for purchasing my game!

This time, I added a lot of things while moving the game development engine to the latest version.

- Add New Mode

The newly added mode can be played in 'normal mode' at the start of the new game, and the existing mode can be played in 'original mode'.

To briefly explain the new mode, it is a low-level mode.
There are some people who have commented on the slippery operation, so the content that should be removed and fostered is slightly different from the existing mode, and overall, I think you can enjoy it comfortably. But if you're challenging yourself, the original mode is also love...


- Add Controller Analog Input

In the previous version of Game Maker 1.4, there was a bug related to analog input in the controller input, so only the direction key was possible, but in the latest version, the corresponding part was modified, making it convenient to operate with analog sticks.


- Add Language
Chinese (Simplified) / Japanese has been added.



- Other bug fixes


If you have a wrong sentence or serious bug while playing, please email 'diskzzang@naver.com'.

notes.title: Hello, my solo game "UNDEMON" has been released.
notes.notes:
Hello

"UNDEMON," a long-term game made by myself, has been released as of November 13 and can be purchased.

We will proceed with early access for 7 days, but if there is no big problem, we will end early access on November 20th.

Anyway, this game is a 2D action platform genre game that feels like the 90s. Therefore, I think those who liked platformers in the past can still have fun. (Like a rock man)

It's a bit difficult. I think so, and you can think of it as a past platformer genre.

Personally, I recommend using the Xbox 360 or higher pad or dual shock 4 of PlayStation 4. (Please understand that I can't give you a definite answer on this part because the dual shock 4 vibration was not mine with Gamemaker 1.4)

The main character is a maiden ghost, so the system may be a little unique.

For those who enjoyed it... Recommendations from people around me... Crying... One-person development has no power, so it's hard to promote it.

The game will be fun...







Whew...


Then please show a lot of interest!
